mentions.name: Astro Starter Template
mentions.description: This is a lightweight, performant, non-bloated, and scalable starter template for Astro. It uses markdown/MDX for content and plain CSS with styling tokens defined in a var.css file, and is well-suited for blogs while avoiding common UI and UX problems.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've also built a starter template for Astro which is light, performsnt, non-bloated and scalable. It uses markdown / MDX for content, plain CSS with styling tokens defined in a var.css, and other things I would use for ever web project. It's very good for blogs also, none of the usual UI and UX problems many blogs often have.
